formal_statement.problem: Signed EXACT-ONE clauses of arity 1 or 3; negative and repeated literals accepted
formal_statement.structural_parameter: w := maximum current primal-neighborhood size along a witnessed variable elimination order
formal_statement.algorithm: Exact existential variable elimination using bounded-size Boolean factors; store all allowed projected tuples and one reconstruction bit for each
proof_sketch: Each original factor enumerates exactly satisfying tuples of its signed exact-one constraint
Existential elimination of one variable produces a logically equivalent factor on its neighbors when conjoined with other factors
Induction across elimination stages preserves existential satisfiability; backwards reconstruction yields a valid model
An empty projected relation witnesses UNSAT; independent local replay detects unjustified projections
A supplied/elaborated ordering of fixed width w bounds each factor scope by w+1 and projected tuples by 2^w
formal_statement.time_bound: O(poly(L) * 2^(w+1)) for the implemented deterministic elimination heuristic and its replay
formal_statement.certificate_size_bound: O(L*(w+1)*2^w) table entries, plus index encoding overhead
formal_statement.polynomial_subclass: Any input on which an elimination order of uniformly bounded width is found; specifically an infinite chain-of-overlapping-cubic-clauses family has width 2
formal_statement.open_condition: OPEN_WIDTH_CAP if heuristic minimum current degree exceeds tested explicit research width cap 2..6
formal_statement.recognition_limitation: Heuristic failure is not evidence that the optimal treewidth exceeds the cap; unrestricted treewidth can scale with input size
formal_statement.historical_context: Classical bounded-treewidth CSP variable elimination; not asserted as a newly discovered general complexity principle

large_family.scalable_family: n-2 windows (i,i+1,i+2), one new overlapping cycle for each consecutive pair

experimental_results.independent_verifier: REPLAYS EACH ELIMINATION STEP BY SEPARATE LOCAL BUCKET ENUMERATOR
experimental_results.proof_witness: SAT original-clause witness; UNSAT empty exact projected factor

research_boundary.next_barrier: Find uniformly poly-bounded relation representation or decomposition / compilation for arbitrary high-primal-width cyclic Exact-One residuals, with polynomial-time recognition, construction, composition and reconstruction
